description:
This file defines a PHP class QualificationEducationSearchFilterParams within the OrangeHRM.Admin
Dto namespace. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies allowed sort fields for qualification education search filtering, notably setting a default sort field.

classes.name: QualificationEducationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for qualification education search filtering, enabling specification of sort fields and potentially other filter parameters inherited from FilterParams.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params object and sets default sort field to 'e.name'.
